traceability.notes: The ESLint configuration story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG is fully implemented. The plugin exports recommended and strict presets as flat-config-ready arrays, with rule severities matching the documented configuration presets. The repository uses an ESLint v9 flat config (eslint.config.js) that follows recommended patterns (array of objects, per-file overrides, explicit globals, ignores) and integrates the plugin conditionally for development and CI. Rule option schemas are defined via JSON Schema for both require-story-annotation and valid-story-reference, with additionalProperties set to false and explicit option handling in code, providing configurable rule behavior and robust configuration validation. Customizable story paths and security-sensitive behavior (through storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension) are implemented in valid-story-reference, and configuration error handling (for invalid branchTypes) is implemented and tested. Tests explicitly associated with this story validate rule schemas and plugin configs, while integration tests confirm the plugin functions correctly under ESLint’s CLI using the flat config. User-facing and internal documentation cover ESLint 9 flat config setup, plugin integration for JS/TS/mixed/monorepo projects, configuration presets, rule options, and troubleshooting. No gaps were found between the story’s acceptance criteria/requirements and the implemented behavior, so the story is assessed as PASSED.
